This fixes the ordinary real24, not an unconstrained complex24. Independent check: neutral Sigma8 gives b3=1/2 and Sigma3 b2=1/3 in threshold tables, the single-real-scalar coefficients T(R)/6, not complexT(R)/3. Therefore one irreducible-real24 module. This resolves earlier unestablished counting by source potential and degrees of freedom, not by assuming every real-type irrep is a real field.
